mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.full_name AS fullName, u.email, u.org_unit_id AS orgUnitId, u.status, o.name AS orgUnitName, o.path AS orgUnitPath FROM app_user u JOIN org_unit o ON o.id = u.org_unit_id WHERE u.id = #{id} AND u.deleted = 0

SELECT id, username, status, auth_source AS authSource, password_hash AS passwordHash, failed_login_count AS failedLoginCount, locked_until AS lockedUntil, last_login_ip AS lastLoginIp FROM app_user WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted = 0

SELECT id, username, status, auth_source AS authSource FROM app_user WHERE deleted = 0 AND (username = #{username} OR email = #{email}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN username = #{username} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id AS roleId, r.code, r.name, r.data_scope AS dataScope, ur.org_unit_id AS orgUnitId FROM user_role ur JOIN role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 'HIEU_LUC'

SELECT DISTINCT rp.role_id AS roleId, p.code FROM user_role ur JOIN role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 'HIEU_LUC' JOIN role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET failed_login_count = #{count}, locked_until = #{lockedUntil} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE app_user SET failed_login_count = 0, locked_until = NULL, last_login_at = NOW(3), last_login_ip = #{ip} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO login_log (username, result, auth_method, ip, user_agent, at) VALUES (#{username}, #{result}, #{authMethod}, #{ip}, #{userAgent}, NOW(3))

INSERT INTO user_session (user_id, refresh_token_hash, expires_at, last_seen_at, revoked, auth_method, ip, user_agent, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{hash}, #{expiresAt}, NOW(3), 0, #{authMethod}, #{ip}, #{userAgent}, NOW(3))
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, expires_at AS expiresAt, last_seen_at AS lastSeenAt, revoked, auth_method AS authMethod FROM user_session WHERE refresh_token_hash = #{hash}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_session SET refresh_token_hash = #{newHash}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, last_seen_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user_session SET revoked = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user_session SET revoked = 1 WHERE refresh_token_hash = #{hash}
UPDATE user_session SET revoked = 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND revoked = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, route, parent_id AS parentId, icon, sort_order AS sortOrder, permission_code AS permissionCode FROM menu WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_order, id
